justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/browser/BrowserStage.java, ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/main/JITWatchUI.java, and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/util/UserInterfaceUtil.java. The target package contains only BrowserStage; it has one internal dependency on the util package via UserInterfaceUtil, and BrowserStage is referenced from only one place in the repo (JITWatchUI). By contrast, UserInterfaceUtil is imported by many UI packages across the codebase, so the browser package does not depend on a less stable package than itself.
